project_type: Full-stack app with Supabase PostgreSQL backend + React/Zustand frontend
build_system: Vite + npm (frontend), Supabase MCP for DB migrations
test_framework: Vitest with vi.mock for Supabase mocking, zustand store unit tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run vitest to confirm all 1205+ unit tests pass. 2. Run vite build to confirm no type errors. 3. Execute SQL via Supabase MCP to verify database changes are live.
environment_constraints: Supabase MCP available for executing SQL on project fbiemsbykrmrbqcsobvh. No local psql access. E2E tests require env vars not available in sandbox.
contribution_requirements: All SQL changes applied via Supabase MCP execute_sql. Frontend changes must pass vitest + vite build. Commit and push to feat/db-baseline-v1.1.5.
key_patterns: Stores use zustand create(). Supabase accessed via fromTable() helper and supabase.rpc(). RPC calls use pattern supabase.rpc('function_name', {params}). publishStore.ts currently does direct UPDATE to template table for publishing. projectCreationStore.ts calls create_project RPC. All RLS policies are in perfecity schema. Functions use SECURITY DEFINER with SET search_path = 'perfecity'.
directory_structure: Root: baseline/, migrations/, tests/, docs/, ci/, frontend/. Frontend: src/stores/ (zustand), src/lib/ (supabase client), src/types/ (database types), src/__tests__/ and src/stores/__tests__/
